rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when text can be understood or deciphered, including functional instructions.

example.english: This instruction manual is clear and readable; I understand it at a glance.
example.traditional: 呢份說明書寫得好清楚，我一睇就睇得明。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 syut3 ming4 syu1 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2 ngo5 jat1 tai2 zau6 tai2 dak1 ming4

rows.note: Use this specifically when the issue is the visual legibility of writing, signs, or print.

example.english: The road sign is only readable when I get closer because its letters are too small.
example.traditional: 個路牌啲字太細，我行近啲先睇得清楚。
example.jyutping: go3 lou6 paai2 di1 zi6 taai3 sai3 ngo5 haang4 kan5 di1 sin1 tai2 dak1 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this for prose or instructions that are easy or pleasant to read, especially in written descriptions.

example.english: This article uses simple wording, so it is very readable.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章用字簡單，讀起上嚟好易讀。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 jung6 zi6 gaan2 daan1 duk6 hei2 soeng5 lai4 hou2 ji6 duk6
